text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
We're here! The classic year! The NHK
Mile Cup!
Who will be the new! Mile!
Master?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Here we are, Trainer! The G1 race we've
been
aiming for!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Next comes the Japan Cup,
and then...
I take off for the world stage!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
What's more, this race is where I say
farewell to
everyone.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. This is where our paths diverge. I'm
on a
different path from the Derby
group.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If I said I wasn't gonna miss them, I'd be
lying. I'm
definitely gonna miss them!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
But I don't have any regrets. This is my
choice.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Someone, somewhere once said,
"Sometimes you
just can't help yourself."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That's why I won't be bringin' these tears
into this
race!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm the condor of the world, and I'm
gonna prove
it here, in the race that
Pearl won before me!
